### New

**Phones and tablets**
- The schematic now opens fitted to the screen (it used to sit small in the top-left corner, partly under the toolbar).
- On narrow screens the toolbar fits on one row; secondary tools (note/box, colors, PNG, Clear, ?) are under a **⋯** menu.
- All touch targets are at least 40 px; tapping near a label is enough (the nearest net / designator is selected).
- In portrait, **Split** mode stacks the panes top / bottom.

**Navigator / Properties panels (schematic + PCB)**
- Clicking a component no longer **forces** the panel open: if you close Properties, it stays closed.
- When the panel is collapsed, vertical **Navigator** and **Properties** buttons stay on the edge; the closed Properties button shows the selected component (`Properties · IC3`). Shortcut `I`.
- On phones a small chip appears in the bottom-right instead of the card; the card opens only when tapped.

**PCB viewer**
- Layers are listed with their Altium names and in stack order (`Int1 (GND)`, `Top Courtyard`, `Route Tool Path`…).
- Mechanical 17 and higher are now separate rows (they were all merged into "Mechanical 16").
- Special strings such as `.Designator` and `.PCBCODE` are drawn with their real values (D4, R55… instead of ".designator" in assembly drawings).

### Fixes
- Components whose Comment is `=Value` now resolve the value from the parameter: the component list, details panel, JSON and the **BOM · Assembly grouping** are fixed (capacitors with different values were grouped together).

### Known limitation
- Inverted TrueType text may overflow its fixed-width box slightly (font metric difference).
